_about: Real SEC filing text, normalized (vinci.graph.filings.normalize_text), cut to the sentences from which the debt-maturity reader takes a statement. Built 2026-10-27 by reading each whole filing and proving `debt_maturities.read` gives the same statements on the excerpt. Public-domain SEC text; `url` is the filing's folder.
